ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2021-01-15
Provider: Dr. Sarah Chen, MD
Department: Psychiatry
Visit Type: outpatient

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Follow-up for chronic delusional disorder with persistent paranoid delusions regarding workplace conspiracy causing continued occupational distress

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
The patient returns for follow-up approximately one year after his initial psychiatric evaluation for fixed beliefs regarding workplace conspiracy. He reports overhearing conversations and seeing emails that confirm his suspicions. The patient is an accountant and states that this situation is causing him significant distress at work. However, he denies any issues with his job performance.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Delusional disorder (diagnosed 2020-01-15)

He has no past psychiatric history.

ALLERGIES:
NKDA

FAMILY HISTORY:
His family history is unremarkable.

SOCIAL HISTORY:
He denies any substance use

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
On examination, the patient appears well-groomed and is cooperative. He does not exhibit any abnormal movements, and his speech is coherent and goal-directed. He denies auditory or visual hallucinations, and his mood is euthymic. His thought process is linear except for the aforementioned delusion. The rest of the physical examination is unremarkable.

LABORATORY DATA:
Laboratory values:
- Complete blood count: within normal limits
- Comprehensive metabolic panel: within normal limits
- Urine toxicology screen: negative
- Thyroid function tests: within normal limits

ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2020-01-15
Provider: Dr. Sarah Chen, MD
Department: Psychiatry
Visit Type: outpatient

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
6-month history of believing that his coworkers are conspiring to get him fired; delayed seeking care because he believes his concerns are valid and justified

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
He reports overhearing conversations and seeing emails that confirm his suspicions. He has been employed at the same job for 10 years and has no prior disciplinary actions. His work performance evaluations have been consistently positive. He has not sought help earlier because he believes his concerns are justified.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
His medical history is unremarkable

ALLERGIES:
NKDA

FAMILY HISTORY:
- Mother: Major depressive disorder
- Father: Hypertension

SOCIAL HISTORY:
He has no history of substance abuse. He is married, has two children, and maintains his social and familial responsibilities.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS:
He denies auditory or visual hallucinations, and there are no signs of disorganized speech or behavior.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
On mental status examination, he is alert and oriented, with no abnormal findings except for his unwavering belief in the conspiracy against him. His vital signs and physical examination are within normal limits.

LABORATORY DATA:
Complete blood count: Normal
Thyroid function tests: Normal
Urine toxicology screen: Negative
